name: Estriol
description: A natural estrogen (female sex hormone), weaker at the estrogen receptor than estradiol

note.text: Both skin studies were in women around menopause and compared estriol with estradiol cream. No placebo-controlled trial was found.

bullets: **Estrogen receptor:** estriol is substantially less potent than estradiol
**In women,** biopsies showed more type III collagen after 6 months
**In rats,** skin effects differed between males and females
**In men,** the effect on skin is not established
Compared with estradiol cream; no placebo

practical.routes: On the skin (0.3% cream) in studies; vaginal cream in EU
practical.monitored: Blood hormone levels, prolactin, breast checks

regulatory.text: No FDA-approved estriol drug; compounded only

references: Schmidt et al., Int J Dermatol, estradiol vs estriol creams for skin aging, Sep 1996
